distribution.verdict: At integer MARKET lines the production curve (the empirical PMF re-centred on EdgeDesk’s fair margin by an integer shift) predicts pushes WORSE than a continuous-normal shortcut (push log loss 0.23693 vs 0.20317): the re-centring moves the key-number spikes off the market’s numbers. Neither is adequate there; see the anchored audit.

extremes.basis: |raw cover − 0.5| and |model − market| at the close, 2022-2025 OOS FBS games (football/cfb_ev/dataset.js)

location.basis: median between-model SD of {V1 fair, V2 walk-forward ensemble} on 2022-2025 OOS games: disagreement at or below this is already absorbed by the calibrated distribution; only the excess is sampled

anchored.note: OOF: each season read with the map fitted on the seasons before it, evaluated at the close and carried by the frozen distribution (fractional moves are mixtures of the two neighbouring integer moves)
